165:t_3:42.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is Her Highness $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$.」

165:t_3:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We will make her the symbol of Earth's humanity and build a new relationship with the $$新地球皇国$$.」

165:t_3:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ will welcome with gratitude all who agree with this vision.」

165:t_3:46.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Everyone... We look forward to your joining $$ネオ・ジオン$$, with the pride and reason of Earth's humanity.」

165:t_3:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I declare it once more. The rightful heirs of Earth's humanity are the people of space.」

165:t_3:53.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What a hideous way to go about it...」

165:t_3:54.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Fearing it would come to this, Lady $$ハマーン$$ must have decided to take back Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, the true $$ジオン$$ bloodline...」

165:t_3:55.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But now even that has come too late...」

165:t_3:58.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$...! You're alive, and you're right here!」

165:t_3:59.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If $$フル・フロンタル$$ is going to win people's hearts with that little girl, you're the only one who can turn that around!」

165:t_3:60.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...But even if the Princess steps out there now, she'll just be crushed.」

165:t_3:61.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...All we can do is wait for our chance.」

165:t_3:62.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Once we've gathered a force to oppose him and defeated him...」

165:t_3:64.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you prepared for that, $$ミネバ$$?」

165:t_3:65.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Reviving the $$ザビ家$$ is not my purpose.」

165:t_3:66.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I will fight so that this world can see a tomorrow.」

165:t_3:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「Understood. Modest as my strength is, I will help you in that.」

165:t_3:69.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ミネバ$$ and I will leave $c and rally anti-$$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces in the colonies.」

165:t_3:70.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you lend us your strength, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

165:t_3:72.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain... There's no such thing as Spacenoids and Earthnoids anymore.」

165:t_3:73.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please fight for the sake of everyone.」

165:t_3:75.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「When I see the $$赤い彗星$$ of the former $$ジオン$$ fighting side by side with an independent Federation unit, even words like those become believable...」

165:t_3:76.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Besides... if I took $$マリーダ$$ back to today's $$ネオ・ジオン$$, all that would be waiting for her is another readjustment...」

165:t_3:78.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm borrowing the $$ガランシェール$$, $$ジンネマン$$. I'll have $$ナナイ$$ examine $$マリーダ$$.」

165:t_3:80.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please look after $$オードリー$$, Colonel $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:81.en:
$$シャア$$
「She no longer needs anyone's support.」

165:t_3:82.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel... If $$ハマーン$$ opposes $$フロンタル$$'s methods, couldn't we ask for her cooperation...」

165:t_3:84.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That depends on you, too, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:86.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then let us go, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:88.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$, let each of us do what we can.」

165:t_3:90.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... I entrust it to you.」

165:t_3:92.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And when that day comes, please reveal the coordinates of the Box.」

165:t_3:94.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I, too, have come to think that we should confirm where those prayers lead.」

165:t_3:96.en:
$$バナージ$$
(It turns into a curse... What does that mean, Ensign $$リディ$$...)

165:t_3:99.en:
$$シャア$$
「Originally, our plan was to head for $$プラント$$ after this.」

165:t_3:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「Something is happening in $$プラント$$ right now. Be careful.」

165:t_3:105.en:
$$リディ$$
(...How long have I been drifting through space by now...)

165:t_3:106.en:
$$リディ$$
(Cast out into empty space like this, I've finally understood...)

165:t_3:107.en:
$$リディ$$
(My family... $$ミネバ$$... $$バナージ$$... Everything is becoming clear...)

165:t_3:108.en:
$$リディ$$
(Could it be that this sensation is...)

165:t_3:110.en:
???
(Do you want power? Power to surpass people... to surpass the present...)

165:t_3:112.en:
???
(You don't know yet... About $$ラプラスの箱$$... the true doctrine of $$クロノ$$...)

165:t_3:113.en:
???
(So I will teach you... And grant you power...)

165:t_10:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$クェス$$, $$カミーユ$$... I leave $$ギュネイ$$ to you.」

165:t_10:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But... I think the words $$ギュネイ$$ is waiting for most are yours, Colonel.」

165:t_10:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I joined $$ネオ・ジオン$$ because the Colonel invited me, but it's the same for $$ギュネイ$$.」

165:t_10:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ is fighting because the Colonel was there.」

165:t_10:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「So I have to take responsibility, is that it...」

165:t_10:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's not only about $$ギュネイ$$.」

165:t_10:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I know. $$ギュネイ$$, $$ミネバ$$, and also...」

165:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The stirring of your heart and $$ギュネイ$$'s has produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

165:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The fight goes on... Carrying the feelings of the world and of so many people...)

165:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Guide us, $$Ｚチップ$$... Lead us to the future...)

kept_omissions: 165:t_3:75: Zinnerman's そんな言葉も信じる気になる has no stated believer; rendered impersonally 'even words like those become believable'.
165:t_3:60: 姫様 (Zinnerman about Audrey/Mineva) rendered 'the Princess'; the line is said in front of her but is third-person.
165:t_3:94: Mineva's 祈りの向かう先 'those prayers' - whose prayers left unstated, as in Japanese.
uncertain: 165:t_3:54: ハマーン閣下 = 'Lady $$ハマーン$$' (matches AG's 'Lady' in 610:t_10:25; no earlier 閣下 precedent found); ミネバ様 = 'Her Highness $$ミネバ$$' (as 598 Zinnerman).
165:t_3:60: 姫様 = 'Princess' (no settled rendering for Zinnerman's term for Audrey/Mineva).
165:t_3:76: 再調整 (Marida) = 'readjustment' - no earlier rendering found.
165:t_3:98: Kira's はい kept as Jigoku's 'Yeah.' although 'Yes.' suits speaking to Char.
165:t_10:11: 赤い彗星様 = 'Mr. $$赤い彗星$$' following AG's 'Mr. X' pattern.
165:t_3:42-47: 宇宙の民 = 'the people of space'; 地球人類 = 'Earth's humanity' (as Frontal in 598/599); 2024_02 Frontal rows written in parallel by another agent, wording may differ.
165:t_3:115: 'black $$ユニコーン$$' uses the robot token; 2023_04 wrote literal 'black Unicorn'.
